description: Welcome home to a classic Temple ranch-style house in the heart of the desirable Woodlawn Park subdivision. This traditional one-story home, built in 1961, has been thoughtfully updated to blend timeless style with modern living. Inside, you'll discover a home designed for effortless flow, with multiple living areas and an inviting entrance foyer. A highlight is the wood-burning fireplace, perfect for cozy evenings with family or friends. The kitchen features an open layout with a range and solid countertops, making it an ideal space for preparing meals while staying connected to the main living area. The primary bedroom features a double vanity and walk-in closet. The home sits on a spacious 0.362-acre lot with a private backyard and perimeter fence, creating an excellent space for outdoor activities and entertaining. The 4-sided brick masonry exterior adds to the home's enduring appeal. Located in the Temple ISD school district, this home offers a prime location with easy access to local amenities and attractions. Enjoy a short trip to the nearby Temple Mall for shopping, or explore the natural beauty of Miller Park and Friar's Creek Nature Preserve. For those who commute, the property's proximity to I-35 makes travel to Waco or Austin a breeze. With its unique blend of classic appeal and modern updates, this home offers a special opportunity. Don't miss your chance to experience it for yourself. Schedule your private showing today!
